name: Natural Ally (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
Natural ally abilities focus on gaining a companion that is also connected to your force of nature and shifting their form as you grow in power.

Natural Ally (Su)

You can draw forth from yourself a manifestation of your connection to your force of nature. This ability functions as a wizard’s familiar arcane bond but uses your conduit class levels to determine its abilities. Any familiar available to a wizard is available but it takes on manifestations based on your force of nature.

Due to the nature of the connection between this natural ally and you, it may not move more than 30 feet from you.

Unlike a normal familiar, the natural ally is not always around and must be summoned. To do so, you must expend a primal point as a move action. Once summoned, the natural ally remains but the primal point expended cannot be regained while they are active. If the natural ally is dismissed or killed, you regain the spent primal point.

This is treated as a familiar for feats and prerequisites.

Shifted Form (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): natural ally primal ability.

You can expend a spell slot of 1st-level or higher to cast a special version of summon nature’s ally of the spell- slot level expended with a duration of 1 minute/level.

You can only summon a single creature, the summoned creature takes the place of your natural ally, and are subject to the following restrictions based on your force of nature:

Fauna – animals, magical beasts, and vermin only
Flames – hot-climate or fire subtype creatures only
Land – land-based or earth subtype creatures only
Ocean – aquatic or water subtype creatures only
Rime – cold-climate or cold subtype creatures only
Sky – flying or air-subtype creatures only
Verdant – The options provided by the Summon Plant Ally feat only. If the summoned creature is reduced to 0 hit points, your natural ally resumes its normal form with 1 hit point. Otherwise, it returns at the end of the duration.
Split Form (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): shifted form primal ability.

When using shifted form your natural ally may shift into multiple creatures as the option provided in the summon nature’s ally spell. The natural ally only resumes its normal form at the end of the duration or if all ‘summoned’ creatures are destroyed.

Wild Form (Su)

Prerequisite(s): natural ally primal ability.

When summoning your natural ally you can instead expend a second primal point to have them take on a more powerful form. This second primal point also does not recover but is refunded when they are dismissed.

The more powerful form of the natural ally is treated as a druid’s animal companion nature bond with restrictions or options based on the force of nature as shown below:

Fauna – any animal
Flames – hot-climate animals only
Land – land-based animals creatures only
Ocean – aquatic animals only
Rime – cold-climate animals only
Sky – flying animals only
Verdant – any option available to the treesinger druid archetype

For the purposes of feats or abilities, this is treated as an animal companion. Your effective druid level for determining the power of the animal companion is your conduit level -4 (minimum 1).
